answer: Pulse-linked marginal-cost auction: each action pays p = b + λ(1+n)^γ, where n counts actions in the last 10s pulse sharing a funding ancestor or relay in the public atlas graph. Independent agents pay near b; a sybil gale from one atlas drives n up, making the k-th action cost superlinearly. Attacker must fund identities through separate channels or serialize across pulses, paying escalating fees and latency/throughput loss; no identity gate.
